title: Songbook and Promise
author: Hazel Eastwick
blurb: Noor Fairweather, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
